title: How one Michigan school district boosted AP class enrollment nearly sixfold
summary_en: At Corunna Public Schools, participating in AP classes has exploded. Leaders say building a culture where students are challenged but supported makes a difference.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: How one Michigan school district boosted AP class enrollment nearly sixfold

title: Backlash led Michigan to ease student vaccine waivers. What happened next
summary_en: Michigan health officials tried making it harder for parents to send their kids to school unvaccinated. Now, relaxed rules are helping counties move away from a policy once credited with sharply reducing vaccine waivers.
author: Kate Wells, KFF Health News
title_cn: Backlash led Michigan to ease student vaccine waivers. What happened next
